text.content:
Plays soldier, runs a protection racket.

Role: Leader of 6th Street (Ganger 8)
Affiliation: 6th Street
Where to find them: The Armory (#80), Arroyo, giving speeches from the roof
Known for: Military theater; the war with the Valentinos

In his fifties, crew-cut, in reading glasses, and a believer in his own speeches. He keeps up 6th Street's ranks and drills, calls the DeadWoods his cavalry, and plays golf with Captain Harlan Mbeki of NCPD Precinct 2.

Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.04, 05, 11
